zh: 圖 1｜三個 Agent 指令與文件分工
箭頭表示建議的工作順序；先審查提案，實作後取得測試證據，再接受與封存。封存後可回到規劃下一次變更。斜線語法依版本與助理核對；四種文件是責任分工，design.md 依需要建立。

proposal.md｜為什麼改、改什麼
design.md｜技術做法
specs/｜候選規格差異
tasks.md｜工作清單

人類先審查文件；Agent 依 tasks.md 實作。
實際執行功能與負向測試，保存結果。

已接受的候選差異 → openspec/specs/ 現行規格
ADDED 新增／MODIFIED 修改／REMOVED 移除
保留提案歷史；封存不證明測試或部署成功。
依官方 Quickstart 的五步關係整理，Apply + Verify 明列本課的驗證責任。箭頭為建議順序，發現錯誤可回修文件；Archive 後回到 Explore 規劃下一次變更。這不是工具強制的品質閘門。
實作、檢查、測試並保存證據。
更新目前規格，保留歷史。
en: Figure 1 | Three Agent Instructions and Their Artifacts

Arrows show the suggested sequence: review the proposal, implement and obtain test evidence, then accept and archive. Return to planning for the next change. Check slash syntax against the version and assistant. The four artifact types divide responsibilities; create design.md when needed.
/opsx:propose

proposal.md | Why and what changes
design.md | Technical approach
specs/ | Candidate specification deltas
tasks.md | Work checklist
/opsx:apply

People review the documents first; the agent implements tasks.md.
Run functional and negative tests and retain results.
/opsx:archive

Accepted candidate deltas → current openspec/specs/
ADDED / MODIFIED / REMOVED requirements
Keep proposal history; archive does not certify tests or deployment.
Figure 2 | Five-Step Collaboration Loop

Based on the official Quickstart relationship; Apply + Verify explicitly includes this lesson’s verification responsibility. Arrows show a suggested sequence. Correct documents when assumptions fail; return from Archive to Explore for the next change. These are not tool-enforced quality gates.
Explore
Clarify the problem and options.
Propose
Propose a change and its requirements.
Review
People review and correct the plan.
Apply + Verify
Implement, check, test and retain evidence.
Archive
Update current specifications and preserve history.
